title: Federated mailbox send to a remote native session fails with 429 'federation peer RPC limit reached' during a multi-part bundle send
outcome: A sender streaming an ordered multi-part message sequence to a remote native session over federation either is never refused by the peer RPC limit at the sender's expected rate, or receives a retry-safe signal that preserves part order; the limit and its retry behaviour are documented.
acceptance: A behaviour test sends a burst of ordered mailbox messages to a federated remote native session and shows that either none is refused, or each refusal is a documented retryable error naming the limit, and an identical-key retry is accepted exactly once.
The federation peer RPC limit (its value, scope and window) and the recommended sender behaviour are documented in the relevant feature doc.
Out-of-order arrival caused by a retried part is either prevented or explicitly surfaced to the receiver (for example by sequence labels), as stated in the doc.
